verdict.rationale: Zulip explicitly documents incoming webhooks as one of its 130+ native integrations (zulip-docs-19), which allow posting messages into a channel via a simple webhook URL, backed by a general 'send a message' API endpoint (zulip-docs-5). This is a well-documented, first-party capability with a large integrations directory supporting it. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook setup simplicity or example payload/URL format in the evidence pack.
